title: Python
description: Run project scripts in the integrated terminal.
interpreterHelp: Executable path or command name. An empty value searches the project's .venv and venv, then the system PATH. Python is installed separately.
missing: Python was not found. Install Python or enter an interpreter path.
directoryHelp: Path relative to the project root. Empty means the project root.
argumentsHelp: JSON array of strings, for example ["--quality", "high"]. Arguments are passed directly to Python.
environmentHelp: JSON object of string values, for example {example}. Saved only on this computer. Python output uses UTF-8.
invalidArguments: Enter a JSON array of up to 64 strings.
invalidEnvironment: Enter a JSON object with up to 64 named string values.
invalidInterpreter: The interpreter path is too long or contains invalid characters.
PROJECT_CHANGED: The project changed. Reload the settings.
